acceptance_checks: A 2-task goal where main carries only the first task file returns completes_goal false, and the pushed head contains no goal complete status or scorecard.
The control case (both task files and the DAG on main, both done) still returns completes_goal true.
A registered single-task goal still returns completes_goal true.
goal_complete for goal A leaves an unrelated in-flight goal B's task file unchanged.
After goal_complete the completing task's ledger_evidence still references the loop's own merge and mark_done ledger ids, and no reverted paths are staged.
A closeout PR carrying cca_rerun_count 2 from the impl PR returns rerun_cca, not stop_blocked.
non_goals: Landing multi-task contracts on main (ADR 0015 T2 owns it — this task only makes the predicate fail closed)

findings.detail: git diff main...HEAD includes mergegate_check.py, shiki_runtime.py, shiki_guardian.py, ADR 0015, CONTEXT.md, and dozens of .shiki records from earlier PRs (#181-#198) of this goal that are unrelated to this task's two changed files (scripts/shiki_loop.py, tests/test_closeout.py, per git status). This is the documented stale-local-main base condition, not content authored by this task; MergeGate computes its base from origin/main where these commits already exist, so they resolve empty. Non-blocking rebase concern, consistent with prior clean reviews in this goal.
findings.title: Diff carries large foreign already-merged mirror/code state (stale-local-main base)

scope: In scripts/shiki_loop.py: (a) compute completes_goal from the coordinator's tasks_for_goal and require every id to be present in the closeout worktree AND done there, so a multi-task goal is never completed on main after only its first task merges; (b) replace the whole-tree 'git checkout origin/main -- .shiki' in the goal_complete branch with an explicit pathspec list built from the completing goal, and re-append the loop's own merge/mark_done ledger ids after the sync; (c) reset cca_rerun_count in the closeout repoint block.
test_command: bash scripts/test_shiki_goal_loop.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_loop_e2e.sh && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
title: Make the closeout path fail closed and stop destroying sibling state
